finding.text: The diff shows `public/framework/ai/doc/task-folders.md` as deleted. The decision doc was committed in the main tree (fb3f98bff) and never on the branch, so this is how a two-dot diff displays it; a three-way merge keeps the file. Check after the merge that `/framework/ai/doc/task-folders.md` still loads (Requirements 1).

Moving the old folders, rewriting the links, the crawl, the Servex restart and telling the other masterminds have not happened yet. STATE.md lists them as ⬜, after this code merges. This diff is the code step only, so they are not failures here (Requirements 3–5).

`AITask.has()` and `StoreFolder.moved()` use synchronous XHR. Each folder hop in `route()` waits on one blocking HEAD, so a deep store URL costs one round-trip per level. It works, but it is a seam to stream or cache later (code).
The diff also carries `2026-10-12/data-grid/*` STATE and requirements files, which belong to another task. They are harmless, but make sure the merge does not overwrite that task's newer lines.
At 400, the drawer-rail buttons "✦AI" and "⋯More" wrap to 3.2 lines (layout.json wraps). This was already there before the diff, which does not touch them (wrapping).
